questions.question: At a passive railroad crossing, who decides whether to proceed?

options.text: The vehicle in front of you.

questions.explanation: A passive crossing has no traffic control device. The driver alone decides whether it is safe to cross the tracks.

questions.question: When exiting a vehicle, you must keep ____ points of contact with the vehicle at all times.
questions.explanation: Face the vehicle and keep three points of contact as you exit. On a bus, use the handrail. Exiting incorrectly can cause you to fail the basic vehicle control skills test.

questions.question: When a school bus picks up students, where should they wait?
questions.explanation: School bus drivers must load and unload students only at designated stops approved by the school district.

questions.question: Before opening the door to let students board, what must you ensure?

options.text: The alternating red lights are on.
The bus is pulled to the side.

questions.explanation: Make sure all traffic around the bus has stopped before opening the door and calling students to board.

questions.question: If you must back up at a student pick-up point, when should you do it?
questions.explanation: Back up only if there is no other safe way to move. If you must back up, wait until all students have boarded the bus first.

questions.question: Before evacuating a bus for safety reasons, what should you do first?

options.text: Ask the students if they want to leave.
Contact your dispatcher and explain the situation.

questions.correctAnswerText: Contact your dispatcher and explain the situation.
questions.explanation: If time allows, call your dispatcher to explain the situation before evacuating. The decision to evacuate must be made quickly.

questions.question: At the end of a basic vehicle controls skills test, where should your vehicle be?

options.text: Within three feet of the position described.

questions.explanation: End each exercise with your vehicle in the exact position the examiner described. Failing to do this correctly can result in failure of the test.

questions.question: While students board a school bus, what should the driver do?
questions.explanation: Supervise students as they board. Watch all mirrors for any students running to catch the bus.

questions.question: How do you perform a conventional parallel parking maneuver?

options.text: Back up past the space, then pull forward into it.
Pull forward past the space, then back into it.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull forward past the space, then back into it.
questions.explanation: Drive past the parking space on the right. Back into the space, keeping the rear of your vehicle as close to the rear of the space as possible. Your vehicle must fit completely within the boundaries.

questions.question: When stopped at a railroad crossing in a school bus, what should you do?

options.text: Be ready to go as soon as a train passes.
Open the door to look and listen for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Open the door to look and listen for trains.
questions.explanation: Do not rely only on signals. Quiet all passengers, open the front door, and look and listen for approaching trains. Check both directions for another train before you cross the tracks.

questions.question: When boarding a school bus, students should:
questions.explanation: Students should board slowly and in a single-file line. They should use the handrail for safety.

questions.question: When a school bus approaches a bus stop, the driver should:
questions.explanation: School bus drivers should approach stops slowly and carefully.

questions.question: If the driving test route does not include a railroad crossing, you:

options.text: Will not have to do anything about crossings.
May have to explain how you would cross railroad tracks.
Will have to take the test again on a route with a railroad crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: May have to explain how you would cross railroad tracks.
questions.explanation: If your test route does not include a railroad crossing, the examiner may ask you to explain and show the proper way to cross railroad tracks at a practice location.

questions.question: A passive railroad crossing:

options.text: Does not have any control devices.

questions.correctAnswerText: Does not have any control devices.
questions.explanation: A passive crossing has no traffic control devices. The driver must decide whether it is safe to cross.

questions.question: A post-trip inspection should include all of the following, except:

options.text: Looking for items left on the bus.

questions.explanation: After each trip, a school bus driver should check for sleeping students, left belongings, open windows or doors, mechanical problems, and damage.

questions.question: When asked to change lanes during the driving test, you should:

options.text: Change lanes right away without looking.
Use your turn signal and change lanes when it is safe.
Change lanes quickly, even if you cut off another driver.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your turn signal and change lanes when it is safe.
questions.explanation: When the examiner asks you to change lanes, check your mirrors and blind spots first, use your turn signal, then change lanes when safe.

questions.question: The overhead inside rearview mirror should show:

options.text: All of the students on the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the students on the bus.
questions.explanation: Position the overhead mirror to see the top of the rear window. This lets you see all students, including those sitting right behind you.

questions.question: When approaching a school bus stop, the driver should:
questions.explanation: Always approach bus stops slowly and carefully.

questions.question: When completing an offset back/right parking maneuver, you should:

options.text: Pull straight forward, then drive straight back.
Drive straight back, then pull forward to the left.
Pull straight forward, then back to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull straight forward, then back to the right.
questions.explanation: For an offset back/right parking maneuver, pull forward first, then back up to the right. Park completely within the space boundaries.

questions.question: Except for straight line backing, a driver may exit their vehicle to check position during testing up to:
questions.explanation: You can exit your vehicle to check position during skill tests. For straight line backing, you can only look once. For other exercises, you can look twice.
